items.title: CONSENT CALENDAR
Approve Modification No. 1 to Contract No. WW-751, As-Needed Sewer Inspection (FY24), with Pipe and Plant Solutions, Inc
items.text: Approve Modification No. 1 to Contract No. WW-751, As-Needed Sewer Inspection (FY24), with Pipe and Plant Solutions, Inc., increasing the contract duration by 120 days, for a revised contract duration of 500 consecutive calendar days (approximately one year and five months), to allow the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission Wastewater Enterprise to continue to issue Contract Service Orders for as-needed sewer infrastructure inspection, with no change to the contract amount

items.title: Award Contract No. WW-769R, Various Locations Main Sewer Inspection No. 3
items.text: Award Contract No. WW-769R, Various Locations Main Sewer Inspection No. 3, to the responsible bidder that submitted the lowest responsive bid, Pipe and Plant Solutions Inc., in the amount of $4,639,125 and with a duration of 455 consecutive calendar days (approximately one year and three months), to inspect existing sewers at various locations within the City and County of San Francisco. This action constitutes the Approval Action for the Project for the purposes of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), pursuant to San Francisco Administrative Code SFPUC September 23, 2025 MINUTES Page 3 of 7 section 31.04(h). The Planning Department has determined that the Project is exempt from the CEQA. The Commission will rely on that determination to make its decision on this action

items.title: Award Contract No. WW-793, Brannan Street Outfall Improvements
items.text: Award Contract No. WW-793, Brannan Street Outfall Improvements, to the responsible bidder that submitted the lowest responsive bid, R&S Construction Management, Inc., in the contract amount of $3,318,205, with a contract duration of 330 consecutive calendar days (approximately 11 months), to rehabilitate the Brannan Street Outfalls, located in the City and County of San Francisco. This action constitutes the Approval Action for the Project for the purposes of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), pursuant to San Francisco Administrative Code section 31.04(h). The Planning Department has determined that the Project is exempt from the CEQA. The Commission will rely on that determination to make its decision on this action

items.title: Award Contract No. DB-139, Transmission Line Clearance Mitigation Moderate and Low Risk Project, to Wilson Utility Construction Company
items.text: Award Contract No. DB-139, Transmission Line Clearance Mitigation Moderate and Low Risk Project, to Wilson Utility Construction Company, in the amount of $59,163,762, and with a contract duration of 1,095 consecutive calendar days (approximately three years), to design and construct clearance mitigations to span the existing San Francisco Public Utilities Commission owned and operated 115 kilovolt (kV) and 230kV overhead power transmission lines; and authorize proceeding only with design and pre-construction services in the not-to-exceed amount of $10,000,000 for a duration of 365 calendar days. (Ritchie) The Commission did not consider Item No. 7
